page.overview:
Who is Kaburamaru?

Kaburamaru is a medium-sized albino Japanese rat snake with reddish pink eyes and large fangs on either side of his mouth. His scales and underbelly are both white due to albinism.

Kaburamaru seems to be an intelligent animal rather than an ordinary snake. In most situations, he is usually seen flicking his tongue to sense his surroundings while coiled around Obanai's neck. He appears to be of similar personality to Obanai himself, as seen when he angrily hissed at Suma for chiding the Serpent Hashira for his late arrival to Yoshiwara. He also seems to be attached to Mitsuri Kanroji, as seen when she stroked Kaburamaru in the past. Additionally, he shed tears as Mitsuri was dying, succumbing to her wounds.

After Obanai's death, Kaburamaru appears to have mellowed out somewhat, as he was shown being entrusted to Sanemi Shinazugawa and later Kanao Tsuyuri, whereas he was initially always with Obanai from the beginning. He is also seen smelling Tanjiro Kamado's face in curiosity.

During his life in captivity to become a sacrifice to the Serpent Demon, Obanai found that a small snake had slithered into his cell. Being the only living thing that didn't want him dead at the time, he took the snake in as a companion. Once he made his escape, he had the snake with him when he fled. The two would end up being rescued shortly after by the Flame Hashira of then, Shinjuro Rengoku.
